# `truncate`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] truncate`

Truncate long output to fit context window

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_chars` | integer | no | Maximum number of characters to keep (default: 8000) |
| `max_lines` | integer | no | Maximum number of lines to keep (default: 200) |
| `text` | string | yes | The text to truncate |
